main_text.p: fidelibus, & à mundi inquinamentis, sanctificati sacramentaliter, per aquam baptismi, repræsentativam sanguinis Novi Fœderis, extrinsecùs abluti; sanctificati etiam inchoatè, quoad aliqualem cordis motum & communia charismata spiritus S. Eidem Hebr. vi. dicuntur γευσαμένους τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς ἐπουρανίου [?], gustu sanè oris magis quàm cordis, labiorum quàm animi, theoretico magis quàm practico; καὶ μέτοχοι γενηθέντες πνεύματος ἁγίου [?], participatione quâdam communi, temporariâ, initiali, qualis & in Saule, Juda, Simone Mago; καλὸν γευσαμένους θεοῦ ῥῆμα, δυνάμεις τε μέλλον-τος αἰῶνος [?], scilicet cognitione quâdam theoreticâ assecuti, & quàm salutaris sit E-vangelij doctrina, & quàm eminens gloria-futuri seculi. III. Utrobique ejusdem criminis, sceleratæ defectionis, & totalis apostasiæ rei supponuntur: Petrus, si iidem illi qui effugerunt mundi inquinamenta, τίνες πάλιν ἐμπλακέντες ἡττῶνται [?], iisdem se rursus implicari, & à maleseriatis hominibus perverti sinant ac superari; Paulus Hebr. x. page.notes: Greek words marked [?] are read from a small, heavy print and may not be exact. The running head is read as "ad Hebræos" but the letters are unclear. The catchword "veri-" ends the page at a line-end hyphen.
